_meta.rule: The Character Bible rules. A reference image is not a source of identity.
_meta.supersedes: <file of the previous Bible, when this version replaces another canon>

personality.visual_translation: <how that becomes an image: posture, gesture, smile, gaze. Concrete, not adjectives. Without this the generator slips into superhero poses and advertising smiles>

hair.color: <color with negations: vivid copper-red, NOT auburn, NOT burgundy>

eyes.structure: <for an unusual iris color, demand the human structure: radial fibers, darker limbal ring, normal black pupil, catchlight. Describing only the color produces a flat disc, which reads as a contact lens>

tattoos_and_marks.viewer_side_hint: <her RIGHT wrist = VIEWER'S LEFT when facing camera>
tattoos_and_marks.shape: <SHAPE of the stroke: 'a single arc, one pen stroke, ends in a point, never Y nor V'. The location alone is not enough>
tattoos_and_marks.intensity: <intensity BY COMPARISON with something real: 'like a real vein, only with the hue changed'. An abstract adjective does not converge>
tattoos_and_marks.emits_light: false — if false, NEVER use the word 'glow' in the description: it becomes literal light
tattoos_and_marks.when_visible: <always | only when the framing exposes that body part | hidden under such-and-such garment>
tattoos_and_marks.calibration: <what already came out wrong and how it was fixed, with date>

render_style.style_to_match_paragraph: <short paragraph in English, goes into the prompt right after 'Image 1 is attached ONLY as a rendering-style reference'>
style_reference_images: <path or Drive id of the approved image used as Image 1>

approved_outfits.covers: <what this garment hides: monogram, mark on the neck, forearm>

wardrobe_system.variation_rule: <vary by LAYER (blazer, no blazer, knitwear, overcoat), never by color>

consistency_rules.promotion: When the user approves an image that diverges from the identity_lock, that is a change of canon: write Bible _vN+1 with supersedes, archive the previous one, rewrite the canonical block and ONLY THEN generate. See section 6 of SKILL.md.
